say:2:1123601002:1.text: We of the Grimmaw Clan are all about strength, so we focus heavily on training our warriors. We've never had mages among us, so we lack experience in dealing with them.
say:2:1123601002:1.source_cn: 黑嚎崇尚力量，重视战士的培养，从未有过魔法师，也因此缺...

say:3:1123601003:1.text: While you all are still here in Ashen Wastes, I'd like to ask for your help in <style="highlight">training these warriors</style>.
say:3:1123601003:1.source_cn: 趁着诸位还停留在荒角沙漠的机会，我想请你帮忙<styl...
say:3:1123601003:1.male: While you all are still here in Ashen Wastes, I'd like to ask for your help in <style="highlight">training these warriors</style>.
say:3:1123601003:1.female: While you all are still here in Ashen Wastes, I'd like to ask for your help in <style="highlight">training these warriors</style>.

say:4:1123601004:1.text: Only by experiencing the power of magic will they stop taking mages lightly.
say:4:1123601004:1.source_cn: 只有切实体会过魔法的强大，他们才不会轻视身为魔法师的对手。

say:0:1123602001:0.text: You're the mage that the Chief said will train us, right? Well, let's get started!
say:0:1123602001:0.source_cn: 你就是族长找来训练我们的魔法师？那就别愣着了，赶紧开始吧！
say:0:1123602001:0.male: You're the mage that the Chief said will train us, right? Well, let's get started!
say:0:1123602001:0.female: You're the mage that the Chief said will train us, right? Well, let's get started!

say:1:1123602002:0.text: We're running low on medicine. Take it easy!
say:1:1123602002:0.source_cn: 唉，伤药可不多了，你们悠着点吧。

say:2:1123604001:1.text: Ah... It hurts! How come your magic can do so much harm?
say:2:1123604001:1.source_cn: 疼……疼疼疼！\n你的魔……魔法，怎么这么厉害？！
say:2:1123604001:1.male: Ah... It hurts! How come your magic can do so much harm?
say:2:1123604001:1.female: Ah... It hurts! How come your magic can do so much harm?

say:3:1123604002:1.text: Ha! What a great battle! But your wounds...
say:3:1123604002:1.source_cn: 嗬，真是一场精彩的较量啊。就是你们的伤……

say:4:1123604003:1.text: Seems like I need to make medicine. Magister, please help me find the <style="highlight">ingredients</style>.
say:4:1123604003:1.source_cn: 看来得再做一批伤药才够用。强大的魔法师，来帮我找一下<...
say:4:1123604003:1.male: Seems like I need to make medicine. Magister, please help me find the <style="highlight">ingredients</style>.
say:4:1123604003:1.female: Seems like I need to make medicine. Magister, please help me find the <style="highlight">ingredients</style>.

say:0:1123605001:0.text: 3 ironjaw teeth, 5 lizard tails. We've got those. 4 snakebone grass... I need more of that.
say:0:1123605001:0.source_cn: 需要钢颚兽长牙三颗，蜥蜴断尾五条……这些都有。就是这四...

say:1:1123605002:0.text: Please help me get some <style="highlight">snakebone grass</style>. I need it to make the medicine.
say:1:1123605002:0.male: Please help me get some <style="highlight">snakebone grass</style>. I need it to make the medicine.
say:1:1123605002:0.female: Please help me get some <style="highlight">snakebone grass</style>. I need it to make the medicine.

say:0:1123606001:0.text: That's enough snakebone grass. Let's go back and give them to the shaman.
say:0:1123606001:0.source_cn: 这些蛇骨草足够了，回去交给萨满吧。
say:0:1123606001:0.male: That's enough snakebone grass. Let's go back and give them to the shaman.
say:0:1123606001:0.female: That's enough snakebone grass. Let's go back and give them to the shaman.

say:1:1123607001:1.text: Oh, snakebone grass! I've been waiting for these!

say:2:1123607002:1.text: I just need to grind it up and put it into the medicine. It's going to taste so bitter... I mean it's going to work so well that those youngsters won't ever forget it!
say:2:1123607002:1.source_cn: 只要把它碾碎放进药里，保准苦得……啊，是效果好得让所有...
